_note: Real filing deadlines. checked: true only where the date itself was read on the official page on 7 Nov 2026. checked: false where the date was worked out from a rule (see basis) or not confirmed. A human should confirm checked: false dates before relying on them.

deadlines.label: Form 11 pay and file (paper, or not both through ROS)
deadlines.basis: eBrief 034/26: without both pay and file through ROS, returns and payments are due no later than 31 October 2026.

deadlines.label: ROS pay and file (extended)
deadlines.basis: eBrief 034/26: Form 11 and payment through ROS extended to Wednesday 18 November 2026.

deadlines.label: CT1 return and balance, year ended 28 Feb 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from Revenue's rule: file and pay on or before the 23rd of the ninth month after the accounting period ends.

deadlines.label: CT1 return and balance, year ended 31 Mar 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from Revenue's rule: the 23rd of the ninth month after the period ends.

deadlines.label: CT1 return and balance, year ended 30 Apr 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from Revenue's rule: the 23rd of the ninth month after the period ends. 23 Jan 2027 is a Saturday; weekend handling not confirmed.

deadlines.label: CT1 return and balance, year ended 31 May 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from Revenue's rule: the 23rd of the ninth month after the period ends.

deadlines.label: CT1 return and balance, year ended 30 Jun 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from Revenue's rule: the 23rd of the ninth month after the period ends.

deadlines.label: VAT return and payment through ROS, Sep-Oct 2026
deadlines.basis: Not confirmed on a Revenue page: assumes the bi-monthly ROS return and payment falls on the 23rd of the month after the period.

deadlines.label: VAT return and payment through ROS, Nov-Dec 2026
deadlines.basis: Not confirmed on a Revenue page: assumes the 23rd of the month after the bi-monthly period.

deadlines.label: VAT return and payment through ROS, Jan-Feb 2027
deadlines.basis: Not confirmed on a Revenue page: assumes the 23rd of the month after the bi-monthly period.

deadlines.label: IRS estimated tax, Sep-Dec 2026 payment
deadlines.basis: Worked out from the IRS table: Sept. 1-Dec. 31 is due Jan. 15 of the following year. 15 Jan 2027 is a Friday.

deadlines.label: IRS partnership and S corporation returns, calendar year 2026
deadlines.basis: Not confirmed on the page: assumes the 15th day of the third month after a calendar year end.

deadlines.label: IRS individual returns, calendar year 2026
deadlines.basis: Worked out from the IRS page: calendar year filers file on April 15 (the page shows the 2026 date). 15 Apr 2027 is a Thursday.

deadlines.label: Cayman fund annual return, year ended 31 Dec 2026
deadlines.basis: Not confirmed on the CIMA page: six months after a 31 Dec year end, as the build plan states.
